newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT falls 2.85 pct,most traded issue.
newsitem.headline: PLDT falls 2.85 pct,most traded issue.

text.p: The Philippines biggest telecommunications company, Philipine Long Distance Telephone Co, fell in early Monday trading, taking its cue from the drop in its American Depositary Receipt (ADR), brokers said.
"PLDT was down in New York last Friday and the local issue just followed suit," said Juanis Barredo, analyst at Citisecurities Inc.
PLDT's ADR lost 75 cents to $29 5/16 last Friday.
PLDT shed 25 pesos, or 2.85 percent, to 850 pesos early in the session and emerged as the most traded issue with a turnover of 59.81 million pesos.
